Privacy policy

This site does not create an account and does not ask you for personal details.

What we store

We set a first-party cookie to remember that you arrived via one of our QR codes and to apply your 5% discount. It contains no personal data — only the code of the placement you scanned, the date, and your discount code.

Analytics

We collect anonymous usage events — such as which pages are viewed and whether a WhatsApp chat was started — so we can measure how well our placements perform. These events are not linked to your identity.

Cookies

The attribution cookie is retained for 30 days. You can remove it at any time by clearing this site's cookies; doing so will reset your discount code.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be raised with your Danga agent when you start a chat.
